title: Correct angle calculation
description: Essential Criteria: Student must correctly calculate the inclination angle of plane AB as 30° from the acceleration and gravitational acceleration.

title: Correct total distance
description: Essential Criteria: Student must determine the total distance traveled from start to stop as 180 m.

title: Acceleration on AB
description: Important Criteria: Student should correctly compute the acceleration on inclined plane AB from the velocity-time data.

title: Deceleration on CD
description: Important Criteria: Student should correctly compute the deceleration on inclined plane CD from the velocity-time data.

title: Time allocation
description: Important Criteria: Student should correctly allocate the total time (13 s) among the three segments using kinematics equations.

title: Segment distance calculation
description: Important Criteria: Student should correctly calculate distances for each segment (AB, BC, CD) and sum them.

title: Physics relationship application
description: Optional Criteria: Student may explicitly relate the acceleration on AB to gravity using sinα = a/g.

title: Sign error in deceleration
description: Pitfall Criteria: Student incorrectly uses sign for deceleration on CD (should be positive magnitude or negative with consistent kinematics).

title: Time misinterpretation
description: Pitfall Criteria: Student misinterprets the time data or fails to subtract times correctly between segments.
